// diagnostic

E0419

`#MustUse` result ignored as a bare statement

What

`#MustUse` result ignored as a bare statement

Why

A `#MustUse` result carries work or a resource that is lost when nothing checks it

Fix

Use the `#MustUse` result, bind it, or explicitly discard it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0419: tests/ui/iter_unconsumed.stderr.

Error [jet.MustUseIgnored]: `Iter<Int>` must be used — it was dropped as a bare statement
  --> tests/ui/iter_unconsumed.jet:4:17
    |
  4 |     nums.lazy().map(fn(n: Int) { n * 2 })
    |                 ^^^
 Why: A `#MustUse` result carries work or a resource that is lost when nothing checks it
 Fix: Bind it (`n: …`) and use it, or discard it on purpose with `.drop("reason")`
